title: the 48 GB host run's own compose project and image tag

findings.claim: ten tests of tests/unit/test_measure48_host_h67.py assert the box's fixed names (trialbox-net, trialbox_db, trialbox-llm-service-1, trialbox-py:1.0.0 made and kept) and H-72's refusal of any trialbox-* image; with the run's own project and tag they fail
findings.severity_basis: the card's change is what the order asks; the assertions cannot hold under it, and changing what a test asserts needs the integrator's ruling, so the branch is red on those ten until the ruling
findings.fix: by the ruling: H-67's ten cases moved to the run's own names; H-72's refusal replaced by the invariant tests/unit/test_measure48_host_own_names_h75.py::test_the_boxs_objects_and_images_are_never_touched_by_a_run (pass, failure at s07, SIGTERM, the cap; the box's project and tags refused; the box's lists identical before and after)

findings.claim: the stub (s05) publishes host ports on 127.0.0.1 (the console 8090, the mail sink 8025 and eleven more TB_HOST_*_PORT); on a host with an installed box one of them may be the box's, and the stub's start would fail after the preflight passed
findings.severity_basis: a run beside a box would end at s05; not reached on a real host
findings.fix: the preflight probes each TB_HOST_*_PORT of the checkout's compose files (default or as set) and refuses a taken one, named with its variable; the bench sets the variable to a free port

findings.claim: on master deploy/poc.sh ran make images whenever the host had Maven, curl and fontTools, also when TB_IMAGE or TB_JVM_IMAGE named other images: make images tags trialbox-py:1.0.0, trialbox-jvm:1.0.0, trialbox-embed:1.0.0, trialbox-backup:1.0.0 and the database image, the box's names, and not the names asked
findings.severity_basis: only with those variables set; a run under its own tag would have built over an installed box's images
findings.fix: other names build by poc.sh's own docker build path on BASE_IMAGE; the box's names keep make images; the Makefile is unchanged

findings.claim: COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME in a user's environment overrides deploy/docker-compose.yml's name: (the containers and volumes) but on master not the networks' fixed names: a project given by -p or that variable split the project from its networks
findings.severity_basis: only when that variable is set on the host; the preflight's and the end's object lists would miss the containers
findings.fix: the networks' names follow compose's own project (${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME:-trialbox}, which -p sets for interpolation too); with none given they are master's; the host run sets it to its --project

findings.claim: three files outside the ruling's six read the names made variable: libs/tb_common/config.py DECLARED lacks TB_COMPOSE_PROJECT (test_config_declared, make guard), tests/unit/test_image_config_scans.py asserts deploy/build_db_image.sh's literal -t trialbox-postgres:16-1, and tools/network_sheet.py prints the compose network name raw (test_network_sheet, three languages)
findings.severity_basis: five tests fail on the branch and pass on master; none changes what the box runs, but the branch cannot ride until they are settled
findings.fix: by the ruling: no TB_ variable for the project or the tag (compose's COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME and TRIALBOX_IMAGE_TAG; config.py unchanged); tools/network_sheet.py reads a network name's default (go, body only; sheets unchanged); deploy/build_db_image.sh keeps the literal box line (test_image_config_scans.py untouched)
